issues.description: Silent semantic change: empty base_image fallback now pins python:3.12 instead of delegating to KFP default.
issues.detail: _set_base_image previously assigned '' on pod-introspection failure so kfp_dsl applied its own default; it now hardcodes 'python:3.12'. This is a runtime behavior change for every user whose pod-image lookup fails, contradicts the surviving 'Use kfp default image' comment, and was shipped under a PR sold as display-only. Split the semantic change out or restore the empty-string contract.

issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE 'python:3.12' duplicated across Python, TS constant, TS fallback, and jinja template.
issues.detail: The RPC get_default_base_image exists specifically to single-source this value, yet the literal is repeated in pipeline.py, CellMetadataEditor.tsx, Commands.ts fallback, and the template. The next bump will leave stale copies. Delete the TS literals and trust the RPC (with at most one clearly-marked emergency fallback).

issues.description: The 'effective base image' precedence chain is reimplemented at three+ sites instead of resolved once.
issues.detail: The fallback chain baseImage || pipelineBaseImage || defaultBaseImage || DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE appears in InlineMetadata.createBaseImageText, the Dialog placeholder, and (in different order) the jinja template. Resolve the effective image once at a single boundary (server or one helper) and pass a single string down so ordering cannot drift.

issues.description: Replacing the inline Input with a Button+Dialog is a UX regression and added framework with no clarity gain.
issues.detail: The old UI was a directly editable Input. The new UI is a 5%-wide Button labeled 'IMAGE' that opens a modal Dialog with new state and lifecycle, requires stepName first, and removes inline visibility of the current value. A placeholder or adjacent label on the original Input would have done the same job in zero new components.

issues.description: get_default_base_image uses a function-local import, hiding the module dependency from the interface.
issues.detail: The RPC handler does 'from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE' inside the function body. There is no circular-import reason given, and nb.py already imports from kale at module scope. Move the import to the top of the file to make the module boundary honest and match codebase convention.

issues.description: Button width:'5%' with label 'IMAGE' inside a flex row is a leaky, fragile layout contract.
issues.detail: A 5% width will not fit the word IMAGE at most viewport widths, and the inline style competes with MUI Button sizing while depending on parent context the component cannot see. Either size by content (auto) with a clearer label like 'Edit Base Image', or own the layout contract at the row level.

synthesis.summary: The panel unanimously rejects this PR as currently shaped. Two P0 issues dominate: pipeline.py silently changes runtime semantics by replacing the empty-string 'delegate to KFP' fallback with a hardcoded 'python:3.12', and the same default string is duplicated across Python, two TypeScript locations, and the jinja template — defeating the purpose of the new RPC. The UI change from an inline Input to a Button+Dialog is also a regression that adds framework without clarity. Fix: single-source the constant through the RPC, restore or explicitly migrate the empty-string contract, resolve the effective image once, and revert toward an inline editable field.
